assets.visualReview: Inspected individually on paper and black backgrounds; no people, human hands, human faces or branding
assets.prompt:
Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-altitude-camp-marker-v1.png` (2400 x 1400): a rocky alpine walking track at high altitude in clear morning light, a plain wooden marker post beside the track with a blank rectangular panel (no text or numbers; the video adds a coded "2,500 m" tag), sparse tussock and stones, snow-streaked peaks behind, thin high cloud; one small empty tent pitched off to one side is optional. No people, hands or faces anywhere in the image; no footprints of a recognisable trail brand, no flags, no real mountain.

Hand-in to `status.md`; provenance `docs/production/claude-pm/assets/hms-y11-b05-provenance.json`.
